outcome: Breastfeeding practices (early initiation, colostrum feeding, prelacteal feeds)
cohort: 361 postpartum mothers in the Garhwal region of Uttarakhand, India.
finding: This study found that while knowledge about breastfeeding was high, early initiation rates remained low, with mode of delivery and family type significantly impacting breastfeeding practices.
mod_finding: Women undergoing cesarean section were significantly more likely to give prelacteal feeds compared to those having a vaginal delivery.
